title: Hamming norm of coordinate slices
statement: For every $n\ge 0$ and every function $f:\mathbb F_2^{n+1}\to\mathbb F_2$, let $f_0$ and $f_1$ be its restrictions to inputs whose first coordinate is respectively $0$ and $1$, viewed as functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$. Then the Hamming norm of $f$ is the sum of the Hamming norms of $f_0$ and $f_1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from $\mathbb F_2^{n+1}$ to $\mathbb F_2$
